message.content:
To **sign in to a Microsoft account**, go to Microsoft’s account sign-in page, enter your email or phone number, then your password, and select **Sign in**.[1][2]

If you do not have an account yet, you can choose **Create an account** from Microsoft’s sign-in flow or use the Microsoft account creation page.[2][4]

If you are having trouble signing in, Microsoft says to use its sign-in helper tool first, and if needed, go to **Contact Microsoft Support** and select **Get Help** or **Contact Support**.[2]
